description: Na₂SrV₂MnO₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.93 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-3.02 Å. Sr is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.57-3.23 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-42°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.76 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-47°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.76 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.25 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.16 Å) and four longer (2.19 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, one V, and one Mn atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, one V, and one Mn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, one V, and one Mn atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, one V, and one Mn atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one V atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, one V, and one Mn atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sr, one V, and one Mn atom.
